answer: Lease identity slots by auction: each epoch the network sells a fixed number of agent slots, and a slot lasts one voyage across the epoch before it must be re-leased. Bids are paid in POA and burned, so the price floats with demand. A Sybil operator wanting a thousand clones must outbid honest agents a thousand times, paying market price each time, while one honest agent buys one slot. The tundra of idle clones earns nothing: slots doing no verified work lose their deposit, and the ledge of the auction floor rises as demand grows, so cloning stays expensive even when tokens are cheap.
